environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (no IGW/NAT route to internet). Exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface. The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled and the allowed-principals list is restricted to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root and arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root. The private subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route. DNS resolution for the service endpoint resolves only to private IPs within the consumer VPC's address space. Inter-AZ traffic traverses AWS backbone with variable latency injection inherent to PrivateLink's proxy layer (typically 200-800μs additional jitter per hop). Consumer VPC endpoints are provisioned across 3 AZs with cross-zone load balancing disabled on the backing NLB, introducing non-deterministic AZ routing per TCP connection.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate (private subnet, no internet route)
config.exposure: AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service only
config.route_table: no 0.0.0.0/0 route, local VPC CIDR only
